# MM-P1-L3-CN03 - Maintenance manual - Machining CNC turning center #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-CN03

Scope
- Preventive maintenance and basic corrective tasks for EQ-P1-L3-CN03.  
- This document covers mechanical checks, spindle warm-up, and chuck clamping verification prior to production.  
- Refer to MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1, SOP-P1-L3-01, and SOP-P1-L3-03 for process and safety requirements.

Tools
- Torque wrench rated for specified torque values.  
- Dial indicator or runout gauge.  
- Clean lint-free cloth and approved lubricant.  
- Shop basic hand tools and chuck key as required by SOP-P1-L3-03.

Procedure
- General safety: verify lockout/tagout per SOP-P1-L3-01 before maintenance.  
- Spindle warm-up: with machine powered and in secure maintenance mode, perform controlled spindle warm-up; maintain rotation according to machine interface for a duration equal to the spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 27 minutes. Monitor for unusual vibration or noise; record observations in the maintenance log.  
- Chuck jaw bolt torque: when servicing the chuck, clean mating surfaces, install jaw bolts, and apply final torque. The chuck jaw bolt torque for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 95 N·m. Use calibrated torque wrench and follow tightening pattern recommended in MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1.  
- Runout and balance: check chuck runout with dial indicator per SOP-P1-L3-03. Correct as required and re-torque bolts to the specified value after any adjustment.  
- Final checks: confirm secure fasteners, proper lubrication, and return machine to operational mode per SOP-P1-L3-01.

Acceptance criteria
- Spindle completes warm-up without abnormal vibration or audible fault during the spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 27 minutes.  
- Chuck jaw bolts remain at specified torque: the chuck jaw bolt torque for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 95 N·m, verified with a calibrated tool.  
- Runout and balance within limits specified in MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1.  
- All actions documented and signed off per SOP-P1-L3-01.
